name: io.github.houtini-ai/amazon-creators
description: Find Amazon products and get back paste-ready affiliate cards - image, price, rating and your tag - previewed inline in Claude Desktop through MCP Apps

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_PARTNER_TAG
environmentVariables.description: Your Amazon Associates partner tag, baked into every generated link

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_CREDENTIAL_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Credential version issued with your Creators API keys, e.g. 3.1

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_MARKETPLACE
environmentVariables.description: Marketplace host, e.g. www.amazon.com or www.amazon.co.uk

environmentVariables.name: AMAZON_MAX_CONCURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent API requests (optional, defaults to 4)
